blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Мы не ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 1st pl.) переговоров.
exercises.why: **ведём** — present tense (1st person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Он ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) тайный дневник.
exercises.why: **ведет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Том ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., past m. sg.) сына на закорках.
exercises.why: **нёс** — past tense (masculine) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: Tom carried his son on his back.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) тайный дневник.
exercises.why: **ведёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Я сама ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., past f. sg.) переговоры.
exercises.why: **вела** — past tense (feminine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Tom had a lot on his mind, so he wasn't paying enough attention to his driving.
exercises.why: **вел** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.ru: У Тома было много мыслей, поэтому он невнимательно ___ машину.

exercises.q: A critic is a hen that clucks while others are laying.
exercises.why: **несут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.ru: Критик — это курица, которая кудахчет, пока остальные ___ яйца.

exercises.q: Ты очень грубо себя ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.).
exercises.why: **ведёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: I once had a wonderful dream: seven porters were carrying my salary.
exercises.why: **несли** — past tense (plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.ru: Мне снился дивный сон когда-то: семь грузчиков ___ мою зарплату.

exercises.q: Она ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., past f. sg.) уединённую жизнь.
exercises.why: **вела** — past tense (feminine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Ты ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) себя как трёхлетка.
exercises.why: **ведёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Эта улица ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) на аэродром.
exercises.why: **ведет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: This street leads to the airfield.

exercises.q: Все дороги ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) в Эльсинор.
exercises.why: **ведут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: От тебя ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) сигаретным дымом.
exercises.why: **несет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Стены ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., past pl.) всю нагрузку от кровли.
exercises.why: **несли** — past tense (plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: The walls carried the full weight of the roof.

exercises.q: Улавливаешь, о чём я ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.) речь?
exercises.why: **веду** — present tense (1st person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: Have you got any idea what I'm talking about?

exercises.q: I used to be an adventurer like you, then I took an arrow in the knee.
exercises.why: **вела** — past tense (feminine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.ru: Когда-то и меня ___ дорога приключений — а потом мне прострелили колено.

exercises.q: ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., imper. sg.) себя соответственно возрасту.
exercises.why: **веди** — imperative (ты, singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Лошадь ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.), а извозчику - деньги.
exercises.why: **везет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).
exercises.prompt: The horse does the work and the coachman is tipped.

exercises.q: ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., imper. pl.) осторожно! Эти дороги коварны.
exercises.why: **ведите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: Drive carefully! The roads are treacherous.
